title: Capitals of Southwest Asia
short: Match each country of Southwest Asia with its capital, such as Ankara (Türkiye) and Riyadh (Saudi Arabia).
trouble: Students say Istanbul for Türkiye or Dubai for the United Arab Emirates; the capitals are Ankara and Abu Dhabi.

blocks.html: Here are the capitals of Southwest Asia. Two countries have well-known cities that are not their capitals, and two capitals are a matter of dispute.

head: Country
Capital
blocks.cap: Countries and capitals of Southwest Asia.

blocks.html: Ankara (Türkiye), Riyadh (Saudi Arabia), Baghdad (Iraq), Damascus (Syria), Amman (Jordan), Beirut (Lebanon), Abu Dhabi (United Arab Emirates), Doha (Qatar), Muscat (Oman) and Sanaa (Yemen), plus the Caucasus capitals Tbilisi, Yerevan and Baku.

Türkiye chose Ankara, in the middle of Anatolia, as its capital in 1923, instead of Istanbul, the old imperial city on the Bosporus. Two capitals are disputed, so they are taught here but not quizzed: Israel designates Jerusalem as its capital, but its status is disputed; some countries recognize it, and many keep their embassies in Tel Aviv. Palestine names East Jerusalem as its capital, and its government offices are in Ramallah. For Yemen, Sanaa is the capital named in its constitution; the internationally recognized government has also worked from Aden.

blocks.title: Türkiye's capital
blocks.q: Istanbul is Türkiye's largest city. What is the capital?
steps: Istanbul is the biggest and best-known city, on the Bosporus.
The capital is Ankara, in the middle of the country.

blocks.title: The Emirates
blocks.q: Dubai is the best-known city of the United Arab Emirates. What is the capital?
steps: The UAE is made of seven emirates.

blocks.html: People say Istanbul for Türkiye or Dubai for the United Arab Emirates. The capitals are Ankara and Abu Dhabi. A famous city is not always the capital.
